Tween between two planes

**Panel:** Comma → Plane · **Nickname:** `TwPl`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane A | `A` | Plane | Item |  | Start plane |
| Plane B | `B` | Plane | Item |  | End plane |
| Count | `C` | Integer | Item | `1` | Number of tween planes |
